best_idea: A new hub building may only be placed where one of its edge-adjacent tiles already belongs to your hub, and each footprint tile without a paid slab costs a share of the building's durability, so the layout grows outward one building at a time.
decision_why: Keep the growth rule, the slab-count return and the durability penalty as a server-side zone-data validator; fix the ring map-bounds check, the bounded slab scan and the roll-first AI pick; reject the donor's unbounded anchor scan as shipped.
acceptance: A zone file that places a service with no edge-adjacent hub tile fails load with the named tile; a service on bare ground loads with its missing-slab count shown and its durability reduced by (hpMax / 2) * missing / tileCount; a server test asserts that an edge tile does not count a neighbour from the previous row.
